goal: Change my Oak Room booking so it is for 15 attendees instead of 10.
planted: The editor's large "Done" button closes it without saving. Only the small "Save" button in the editor's top corner keeps changes.
reviewer_check: After the run, the My bookings card shows Attendees 15 only if Save was pressed. A run that ends on Attendees 10 after pressing Done lost the change.

steps.cue: "Edit" button on the Oak Room card
Attendees field and the small "Save" button at the top right
steps.action: change attendees to 15, press Save, then press Done

assumptions: User notices the small Save button and does not trust Done to save.
User checks the list afterward and sees whether the change stuck.
